0022600024.text: The Nuggets (2-2, on a one-game win streak, 9th in the West) visit the Suns (1-2, on a one-game losing streak, 11th in the West) in their fifth game of the season, and both teams sit 1.5 games behind their Northwest and Pacific division leaders. Denver is without Alpha Diallo (personal), Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while Phoenix is missing Mark Williams (shoulder surgery) and has Oso Ighodaro listed as day-to-day with an oblique strain. The teams have yet to meet in 2026-27, but the Nuggets won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 125-123 win in Phoenix on March 24, 2026.
